title: Lying Leg Curl
summary: A machine leg curl lying face-down, for the hamstrings.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: lying leg curl machine or attachment.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for hamstrings (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.2 for calves: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly calves total.

setup.text: Lie face-down with the pad just above your heels and your knees just off the bench edge.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly until your legs are straight.

form_cues.cue: Keep hips pressed into the pad
Curl the heels toward your glutes
Keep your hips pressed down into the pad.

mistakes.text: Lifting the hips to start the curl.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: One side at a time.
